messages:
jamal_t: Heads-up — CI on main turned red after the lockfile regen earlier. Quick look shows a bunch of macOS wheel import errors. Ping @alex_k @maria_g for bisect help :thinking:

alex_k: link to the failing job? can you paste the failing test name/log snippet?

jamal_t: https://ci.internal/runs/12345 (job 12). failing tests: `tests/integration/test_routing.py::test_kv_cache_reconnect` and `tests/test_http_clients.py::test_url_parsing`. Here's the top of the failure:
```
E   ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'rfc3986'
E   During handling of the above exception, another exception occurred:
E   requests.exceptions.InvalidURL: Failed to parse URL 'https://...'
```

ci-bot: Job 12345 — linux/py3.10: passed, macos/py3.10: failed (exit code 1) — see artifacts: https://ci.internal/artifacts/12345

maria_g: that `rfc3986` bit screams transitive pin from the new `httpx` / `rfc3986` bump. Did the lock regen pick up a newer httpx?

jamal_t: lockfile diff shows `httpx 0.24.0 -> 0.25.0` and `rfc3986 1.5.0 -> 2.0.0` in poetry.lock. I haven't dug deeper yet.

alex_k: thanks. can you run the quick bisect script? `scripts/ci/lock-bisect.sh --start HEAD~5 --end HEAD --target rfc3986` — it'll try to pin older versions and rerun the macos job.

jamal_t: running now. kicking off rerun for a few commits. will post results shortly.

jamal_t: bisect result: culprit commit 9c8d3f2 (lock regen). pinning `rfc3986==1.5.0` locally makes the macos job pass.

maria_g: perfect repro. probable cause: rfc3986 2.x changed public API that our internal util expects. we should either adapt code (preferred) or keep transient pin for now.

alex_k: what's the fastest fix to unbreak main? we need to get green for dependent PRs.

maria_g: two options: 1) revert lockfile regen commit and re-run CI, or 2) open a hotfix PR that pins `rfc3986==1.5.0` in pyproject/lock and add a TODO to upgrade with migration. revert is faster for short-term.

jamal_t: I can open the revert PR in 10m. will link it here.

ci-bot: PR #6789 created by jamal_t: revert lock regen — triggers CI.

jamal_t: https://git.internal/r/PR/6789 — re-run CI triggered.

sara_p: I'll watch the PR and merge once CI is green. also can follow up to create an issue to track upgrading to rfc3986 v2 and any httpx changes.

alex_k: thanks everyone. after this stabilizes, let's add a note to the release checklist to smoke-test key integration tests on macos before lockfile merge. :thumbsup:

maria_g: agree. filing issue now -> https://issues.internal/RED-4123 (upgrade rfc3986 + httpx compatibility).

jamal_t: CI passed on revert PR, merged. main green again. closing the loop — thanks for the quick help. :rocket:
